scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.db:setup: cd apps/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply sentinel --local && tsx scripts/seed.ts > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute sentinel --local --file .seed.sql
scripts.dev: npm run build && cd apps/api && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd apps/api && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && cd apps/api && wrangler deploy --env test
scripts.db:setup:test: cd apps/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply sentinel-test --env test --remote && tsx scripts/seed.ts > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute sentinel-test --env test --remote --file .seed.sql
